messages:
ida_pm: Quick follow-up from observability sync. Need final EA scope call: dashboards (per-route cost + 24h), sampled traces for model spans, error analytics, and per-customer CSV export. Who can take ownership?

noah_infra: I can own pipeline changes. Main risk: schema migration and storage cost for traces if sampling is too high.

zara_obs: Recommend two-track data model: billing-grade aggregates (accurate, exportable) + debug-grade sampled spans. That keeps invoices reliable.

kevin_sre: Operational note: default sampling 0.5% + 100% capture on errors and heatlist routes. Keep sampled spans 7d, aggregates 90d. Add on-demand full-capture toggle for support sessions.

mia_design: UX asks: filter by model, deployment type, route, and API-key. Also add a small billing tooltip that explains token->cost calc.

acme_cust: Acme needs per-API-key daily CSV for procurement. Also need trace correlation id to map to invoices. Without that, we can't sign EA.

ida_pm: Action: add `x-rd-request-id` header propagation and include in billing logs + spans. Add CSV export endpoint for API-key/day as part of EA if infra confirms retention.

noah_infra: Plan: week1 schema + migration; week2 runtime hook; week3 aggregation + export; week4 Console UI + alerting. Parallelize where possible.

zara_obs: Regression alerts: nightly job runs prompt-sets, stores failing examples (anonymized) for 30d, and creates alert if pass-rate drops >5%.

kevin_sre: Acceptance gates proposal:
1) Cost dashboard totals match billing for 3 test customers within 2%.
2) Tracing hook emits model.exec span in sampled sessions.
3) Export tested with large CSV generation.
4) Private deployment opt-out for example collection documented.

ida_pm: Tradeoffs to highlight during prioritization: sampling fidelity vs cost, retention length, and export throughput. If we need cuts, prefer shorter trace retention over removing export.

mia_design: I'll push compact mockups for the cost page and the error drilldown by EOD tomorrow.

deploy-bot: staging deploy queued: observability-ea-v1 -> staging at 1717303200 by CI.

noah_infra: I'll draft the schema PR today and loop SRE for retention review.

acme_cust: Sounds good — we'll provide a sample invoice to validate numbers.

ida_pm: Thanks all. I'll bring this to prioritization board and post final cuts after the review. :thumbsup:
